response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), grp AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rfistat), q AS (SELECT g.rfistat, g.avg_mod, g.avg_mod - o.overall_avg AS above_overall FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE g.avg_mod > o.overall_avg) SELECT rfistat, avg_mod AS avg_modindex, above_overall AS diff_from_overall_avg, avg_mod - (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) FROM q) AS diff_from_qualifying_mean FROM q ORDER BY avg_mod DESC
